integrity: All stated counts follow from the Hall basis and projective binary quadratic classification, with reproducible direct finite-field checks. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Covers only central-line quotients of the rank-two free nilpotent class-four Lie algebra; the exact field-uniform distribution is proved and corroborated by finite checks, not externally audited. Literature-priority checks are bounded.
title: A binary-quadratic census of central quotients of the rank-two free class-four Lie algebra
